0022600217.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Washington Wizards (4-7, on a four-game losing streak) in the Pacers' 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams having played 11 games. Indiana is 3rd in the Central, 4.5 games back, while Washington is 4th in the Southeast, 2.5 games back. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), who is averaging 21.8 points per game this season, and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, after the Pacers lost 1-3 to Washington in 2025-26, including a 131-118 loss in Washington on February 20, 2026.
